book.name: 2 Akaasesalonike
book.title: Lihamba lya ubhili lya Paulo kwa Akaasesalonike

content: Nnyupe kwa Chapanga kwa kya twenga
Kuuhiko, maalongo, mutuyupile ngati lilagho lya Bambo likwile kyanalumu na kuhokamilwa kwohele kanongola, na kukingamwa kwa uhokamo handa payibheghite kwa mwenga.
Nnyupe bhubho ngati Chapanga katulopohe na bhandu ahakata na ahokelo, kiyaha nga bhoha ng'obhe bhaahyubhalila lilagho ali lya Maha lya Bambo ghwetu Yesu Kilisito.
Peni Bambo ndo ghwa kuhyubhalika, naywo kataatengeleha mwenga na kubhakingikiha na yula nhokelo.
Na twenga tubhegha na lyakulidumbila mu Bambo kukita mungutenda na maaghendelela kutenda ghala ghatubhakwilikihite.
Bambo kayilongohe myoyo yenu mu upalo ghwa Chapanga na mu ulimbililo ghutukamuhitwe na Kilisito.
Lukinyo lwa kya atotoho
Maalongo, tunguakwilikiha kwa Lihina lya Bambo ghwetu Yesu Kilisito, mulibhike kutali na nnongo ywohele ywakabheghite ntotoho na ywene ywangatughila malaghilo ghatubhapeghite.
Kiyaha mabhene mungumanya kya bhuli yinguakwiliha kutughila nhwano ghwetu. Twenga patubheghite na mwenga tukibha atotoho ng'obhe.
Hangi tukilyegha ng'obhe hilyo hya mundu ywohele kyangahemela. Kihyengo kyaki tukitenda lihengo kwa ukangamalo na kwa himbamanda pakilo na pamuhi, ngati tukotoke kuntweneha mundu ywohele mu mwenga.
Tukitenda habhu ng'obhe kiyaha tukibhegha ng'obhe na shaliya ya kukamuhwa utangwo ghwenu, ngati twenga twabhene tubheghe nhwano ghwene mwenga yibhakwiliha kughutughila.
Kiyaha patubheghite papamu na mwenga, tukiakwiliha kukita, “Mundu ywohele ywangatenda lihengo, kakotoke kulyegha hilyo.”
Tungulongela malagho agha kiyaha tunguyihwa kukita amoo bhandu mu mwenga abhegha atotoho. Bhangutenda ng'obhe lihengo ngati bhanguyingilila milando ya bhandu bhangi.
Hino bhandu handa abho tungubhalaghila na kubhakinya kwa lihina lya Bambo ghwetu Yesu Kilisito, kukita bhatende lihengo kwa utetebhalo ngati bhalyeghe hilyo hyabhe bhene.
Peni mwenga maalongo, nkotoke kutotokela kutenda milando ya umaha.
Handa mundu ywohele kangughayitikila ng'obhe malaghilo ghetu ghaabheghite mu lihamba ali, munnolekehe munu mundu aywo. Nkotoke kulilunga naywo, ngati kabhone honi.
Nkotoke kummona mundu aywo handa nmyanja, peni munkinye handa nnongo.
Majambuho gha uhiko
Hino, Bambo ghwa uhihimilo mwene kabhapeghe uhihimilo mu manjubha ghoha kwa njila yohele. Bambo kabheghe na mwenga mabhoha.
Nenga Paulo nungutyeka majambuho agha kwa kibhoko kyangu numwene. Nungutenda naha mumahamba ghangu ghoha. Habhu ndo mundyekagha.
Umaha ghwa Bambo ghwetu Yesu Kilisito ghubheghe na mwenga mabhoha.
